clips.title: The story
paras: Longwalker Malah is a missing tauren scout dispatched to survey the eastern borderlands of Mulgore on behalf of Bloodhoof Village. As an elite Longwalker answering directly to the High Chieftain, her sudden failure to return after three days prompts an urgent search to ensure both her survival and the safety of the valley.

The Longwalkers serve as the eyes and ears of the shu'halo, renowned across the plains for their tireless stride and survival prowess. Pledged directly to High Chieftain Cairne Bloodhoof, these elite scouts are tasked with traversing vast territories to gather intelligence and deliver vital messages. Though their ultimate loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine Bloodhoof occasionally calls upon their aid to safeguard the settlement of Bloodhoof Village and its surrounding pastures.

Dispatched to monitor Mulgore's eastern borders, Longwalker Malah Longwind ventured out on a routine three-day reconnaissance run. When she failed to return to Bloodhoof Village on schedule, concern spread among the village leadership. Given the vital intelligence Longwalkers carry and the ever-present dangers lurking along Mulgore's frontier cliffs, scouts and willing travelers are called upon to seek out her trail and confirm her safety. Malah can be recognized by the traditional markings of her order: a ceremonial headband and a feathered staff.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: The Longwalkers are our people's most trusted scouts. Though their loyalty lies with the High Chieftain alone, young Baine at times seeks their aid.
This is one such time. Longwalker Malah was dispatched near our borders to the east and did not return last night after three days. When this occurs, it is our duty to confirm their safety.
I must ensure the village remains safe. Prove yourself, and seek Malah out. You will know her by her headband and feathered staff, emblematic of the Longwalkers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Es ist offensichtlich, dass Malah keines natürlichen Todes gestorben ist. Ihr Rücken und der Boden um sie herum sind mit Pfeilen übersät.
